notes: 22 primary dispatch state/completion/restore methods plus two movement-state helpers form24 reviewed C routines. No original class or function names asserted.
Four repeated two-phase timer bodies and five encoded member-call sites share source macros derived from original instructions. No external gameplay code copied.
Primary dispatch evidence stops at38 bytes; neighboring bad_alloc strings and exception/runtime tables are not treated as additional gameplay methods.

Old member-pointer encoding preserves zero/negative/positive selector paths, signed16 adjustments, captured versus reloaded indices, and32-bit address wrap. Draft m2c incorrectly narrowed the adjustment sum to16 bits.
Soft-double runtime values in the stop-vehicle update use full64 integer-register bits; float virtual argument is independent f12. Runtime roles corroborated by research agent.
Float constants are exact instruction-derived words3727C5AC,3C23D70A,40C90FDB,40A00000 and zeros/ones. Strict comparisons preserve unordered behavior.

Idle signed remainder follows original target division for valid goal counts; original has a division-by-zero break when an invalid count reaches a modulo operation. No extra stale call arguments or invented null checks.
Every registered function is reconstructed until a complete linked byte/length gate succeeds. Optional guarded SAVE128 annotation is declared only for routines originally using sq/lq saved registers.

Root independent full-instruction review passed all complex nonmatching paths, including full32 member adjustments and drive index reload, idle seven integer args plus f12, route word/byte alias ordering, stack vector output, XZ projection/reciprocal squared length, and full64 software-double stop logic.

Second independent exceptional-path review passed all nine requested member/idle/route/output/soft-double routines. Ignored native32 harness passed127 checks; these support semantics and never substitute for target byte comparison.
